website.readmeExcerpt:
# Pet Nicknames
Give your minions, Carbuncles and Faeries cute nicknames and share them with your friends.

## Tutorial
Type [/petname] to open the pet rename window. If you dont have a minion or battle pet out it will give you a warning.

![](https://github.com/Glyceri/FFXIVPetRenamer/blob/main/res/NameWarning.png)

Summon any companion or battle pet and you will see this pannel. In some cases you need to click edit. Click edit and type a name in the bar that appears then click `save`.

![](https://github.com/Glyceri/FFXIVPetRenamer/blob/main/res/NameEnter.png)

The outcome should look as follows:

![](https://github.com/Glyceri/FFXIVPetRenamer/blob/main/res/Outcome.png)

You can remove a nickname at any point by clicking Clear Nickname.

raw_manifest_json.TestingChangelog:
[Pet Nicknames 3.0.0.0]

Helloooo helloooooo!
This is a majour rewrite of Pet Nicknames that has been ongoing for the last year.
Sorry this took so long.

- Added support for Beast Master naming.
- Added an ephemeral chat replace (on by default) where chat messages will update retroactively and disappear when the plugin turns off.
- Massive stability improvements, naming is now much more consistant, and lots of UI elements will update themselves.
- Slight UI rework.
- Added multiple languages (If your language is missing, feel free to message me). [French (Matias49), Japanese (Epinephren), German (Epinephren), Chinese (MapleRecall), Dutch (Glyceri), English (Glyceri)] 
- It *should* now work on the non-global clients too.
- Added support for LOVM (I think)
- Added (proper) support for Island Pets.

Please notify me of any remaining issues. 
It's hard to find them all on my own.
